title: Ecowitt Sensor Upload Gap
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecowitt:obs
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by sensor_id
| eval minutes_since=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)
| where minutes_since>30
| sort - minutes_since
description: Uses Ecowitt sensor uploads telemetry to monitor how long each station sensor has been quiet in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for outdoor devices that stopped reporting before a storm hits, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Ecowitt sensor uploads data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Sensor table of minutes since last upload.
grandmaExplanation: It builds how long each station sensor has been quiet so you can spot outdoor devices that stopped reporting before a storm hits before it becomes annoying.
